name: Barley Vegetable Pilaf
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ⅓ cup pearl barley, rinsed and soaked 1 hour
1 carrot, 1 celery stalk and 6 beans, diced
1 bay leaf and 1 tsp dried thyme
Black pepper, salt, lemon juice and parsley
1 extra cup non-starchy vegetables (spinach, cabbage or green beans), chopped
steps: Heat the oil and cook onion, carrot, celery and beans for 6 minutes. Add garlic, bay leaf and thyme.
Add the extra chopped vegetables together with the other vegetables.
Add the drained barley and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 30 minutes until the barley is tender and the liquid absorbed.
Fluff and finish with pepper, lemon juice and parsley.
note: Barley is high in beta-glucan, a soluble fibre associated with lower LDL cholesterol.
